prompt: Create an original 150 second neoclassical felt piano instrumental composition for exercise, action montage and energetic motion. Mood: energetic, driving, determined. Instruments: felt piano, soft cello. Style: spacious broken chords, intimate close room. Tempo approximately 80 BPM; B minor. Main idea: a repeating five-note figure with space between phrases. Use strong rhythmic articulation and maintain momentum from the first bar. Instrumental only. No vocals, no choir, no humming, no singing, no speech, no lyrics, no vocal samples. Do not imitate any existing artist or melody. [00:00-00:50] Establish the main idea immediately with the core ensemble. [00:50-01:40] Develop the motif with a complementary instrumental counterline, preserving the intended energy. [01:40-02:30] Return to the main idea and give a musically resolved ending with a short natural tail. Finish around 02:30.

description.en: A classical-inspired instrumental piece featuring a prominent piano melody, supported by a rich string section with both bowed and pizzicato elements. The arrangement builds in complexity and emotional depth, incorporating subtle synth pads and light percussion, creating a reflective and dramatic atmosphere.
description.zh: 一首受古典乐启发的器乐作品，以突出的钢琴旋律为主，并由丰富的弦乐部分（包括弓弦和拨弦）支撑。编曲在复杂性和情感深度上逐渐增强，融入了微妙的合成器衬底和轻柔的打击乐，营造出一种沉思而富有戏剧性的氛围。

metadataBasis: style/scenario/tempo/key/moods are prompt intent; duration is measured; energy and audioReview are model inference when energyBasis is automated-audio-review
